name: Orphan Matron Battlewail
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Orphan Matron Battlewail shelters children left without families by war. With Tosamina, she raises young orcs.

sections.title: Caretaker of the Horde's Youth
sections.body:
In Orgrimmar, a young capital already touched by war, Orphan Matron Battlewail and Tosamina shelter children who have lost their kin to violence. They nurture the Horde's next generation in the orphanage of the Valley of Honor.

The orphanage opens its doors to passing adventurers. During Children's Week, travelers are called upon to mentor the children.

faq.answer: Orphan Matron Battlewail oversees Orgrimmar's orphanage. She shelters and raises children whose parents died in battle.

faq.q: Where can she be found in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Battlewail and Tosamina care for children in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, in the city's eastern reaches.

faq.q: What is her role during Children's Week?
faq.answer: During Children's Week, Battlewail sends willing champions out with an orphan to show them the wonders and heritage of the Horde.

faq.q: Who assists Battlewail at the orphanage?
faq.answer: Tosamina lives and works alongside Battlewail. She helps watch over and protect the children in their care.

angles.text: For the Horde, Battlewail shelters and guides children left behind by war, helping preserve the people's future.
As an orc seeking a lasting homeland in Durotar, you can see in Battlewail's orphanage the sacrifices your people endure.
